no_project: This server reads no folders: write the code and diffs into the Markdown.
no_project_dir: This server cannot read project_dir ({given}): it is shared and sees nothing on your machine or its own disk. Start again without project_dir, read the files yourself, and put the code in the Markdown: a fenced block with start= for the first line number, or a unified diff block.
no_disk_block: Line {line}: {what} was not shown: this server cannot read files or git.
no_disk_fix: Read it yourself and paste the lines into the block, with start= for the first line number; for a change, paste a unified diff into a ```diff block or use old/new blocks. Send the fixed slide with revise_slide.
no_images: Line {line}: the image was not shown: this server takes no images, from paths or from the web.
no_images_fix: Draw it instead: ```svg, a ```mermaid diagram, a ```chart, or a table. Send the fixed slide with revise_slide.
no_export_path: This server cannot save to {given}: exports stay on the server for the owner to download. Call export_walkthrough again without path.
guide_hosted: **On this server:** it reads nothing from disk or the web. Where the guide below says `file=`, `rev=`, `svg file=`, `drawio file=` or an image, put the content in the Markdown instead: code in a fenced block with `start=` for its first line number, a change as a unified ```diff block or old/new blocks, a picture as ```svg, a diagram or a chart.
exported_hosted:
Saved on the server ({mb} MB, {duration}). The owner can download it, signed in, from {download}
Give the user that link with a line on what it covers. Anyone they send the file to can play it. Don't repeat the script.
markdown_too_big: This call carries {kb:.0f} KB of Markdown; the limit is {limit:g} KB per call. Send fewer slides per call.
too_many_slides: Not added: that would make {n} slides, over this server's limit of {limit}. Finish this walkthrough and put the rest in a second one.
narration_limit: Not added: that would make about {minutes} of narration, over this server's limit of {limit:g} minutes per walkthrough. Shorten what you send, or finish here and put the rest in a second walkthrough.
writing_limit: Not started: you have {n} walkthroughs in progress, this server's limit. Finish one with finish_walkthrough first: {handles}.
stored_limit: Not started: you have {n} walkthroughs stored, this server's limit. Ask the user to delete old ones from the gallery page.
storage_limit: Not started: your walkthroughs use {gb:.1f} GB, over this server's limit of {limit:g} GB. Ask the user to delete old ones from the gallery page.
export_busy: Not exported: another export of yours is still running on this server, which makes one per user at a time. Wait for it to finish, then call export_walkthrough again.
chromium_busy: The server's browsers stayed busy for {s:g} s with other people's checks; try again in a minute.
rate_limit: Too many calls: this server allows {n} tool calls a minute per user. Wait a minute, then send more slides per call.
share_bad_email: {email} is not an email address; nothing was changed.
share_domain: {email} is outside this company's domains ({domains}); nothing was changed.
share_too_many: Not shared: that would make {n} people, over this server's limit of {limit} per walkthrough; nothing was changed. Share it with the whole company instead (company=true).
share_local: Sharing is for hosted servers; this one runs on the user's machine.
shared:
Shared with: {people}. Whole company: {company}. Link: {url}
Tell the user who can open it now.
share_unknown: Nobody has signed in to this server as {emails} yet; added anyway, since they may not have signed in. A share matches the address people sign in with: for Entra, their sign-in name, which can differ from their email. Tell the user, and if one of them still gets "not found" after signing in, share with the address they sign in as.
